title: Periodic Table Builder — First 18 Elements
guideExplore: Click a tile in the table (or use the Element controls) to see its Bohr model. Try a tour button to explore a reactive family!
guideAlkali: Alkali metals (Group 1) have just 1 electron in their outer shell — that makes them extremely reactive.
guideNoble: Noble gases (Group 18) have a completely full outer shell, so they almost never react.
guideHalogen: Halogens (Group 17) are one electron short of a full shell — very reactive nonmetals.
elementHint: Columns (groups) share outer-shell electrons; rows (periods) share the number of shells.
learnMore: Every shell holds a limited number of electrons — 2 in the first shell, 8 in the second and third (for these 18 elements).
quizQuestion: In the Bohr model, where are an atom's electrons found?
quizCorrect: In fixed shells (orbits) around the nucleus
